description: This file contains unit tests for the SimpleDosingInstructions class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation and expiration date calculations for DrugOrder objects.

classes.name: SimpleDosingInstructionsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing validation and expiration date logic in the SimpleDosingInstructions class related to DrugOrder objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAutoExpireDateIsNotSetAndDurationUnitsIsNotMappedToSNOMEDCTDuration
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the auto-expire date is not set and the duration units are not mapped correctly.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAutoExpireDateIsSetAndDurationUnitsIsNotMappedToSNOMEDCTDuration
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes if the auto-expire date is set even when duration units are unmapped.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAutoExpireDateAndDurationUnitsAreNotSet
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when both auto-expire date and duration units are null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateForAKnownSNOMEDCTDurationUnit
methods.description: Checks that the auto expire date is correctly inferred for a known SNOMED CT duration unit.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateForScheduledDrugOrder
methods.description: Validates calculation of auto-expire date for a scheduled drug order based on scheduled date and duration.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldInferAutoExpireDateIfDurationIsSet
methods.description: Tests auto-expire date inference when duration is explicitly set.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenDurationDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that no auto-expire date is inferred if duration is null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenDurationUnitsDoesNotExist
methods.description: Checks that no auto-expire date is inferred if duration units are null.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate_shouldNotInferAutoExpireDateWhenConceptMappingOfSourceSNOMEDCTDurationDoesNotExist
methods.description: Ensures that auto-expire date inference fails when concept mapping details are missing for the source SNOMED CT code.

methods.name: createValidDrugOrder
methods.description: Helper method to create a valid DrugOrder object with preset properties for testing.

methods.name: createConceptWithName
methods.description: Creates a Concept object with a specified name for testing purposes.

methods.name: createUnits
methods.description: Creates a Concept representing dosage/duration units with specified source and code.

methods.name: getConceptMap
methods.description: Builds a ConceptMap object linking the concept to a concept reference term and source.
